findings.headline: Customers are buying on-site power; our named open-gap estimate is conditional.
findings.meaning: Two 2027 campus leads at 50% buildout, after known supply and a 50% competing-supply haircut.
findings.financial: At 25% capture, roughly seven 25-MW units; not enough evidence to fill 100 deliveries from this sample.

findings.headline: Lower percentage margins have not stopped AP profit dollars growing.
findings.meaning: Higher sales/workload, growing gross profit and lower overhead intensity support growth-driven dilution.
findings.financial: Sustainable cash returns and like-for-like unit economics still require validation.

findings.headline: The hiring signal is industrialization, not a headcount growth estimate.
findings.meaning: Configuration, supplier development and factory testing map to actual ramp bottlenecks; a recruiter post adds planning evidence.
findings.financial: Supports execution investment; does not establish hires completed or units per quarter.

findings.headline: WestJet separates externally owned service exposure from AP feedstock.
findings.meaning: 17 SCI aircraft imply 34 positions; ten separate AP aircraft imply twenty more positions.
findings.financial: SCI II can create MRE opportunities without FTAI owning all airframes; prices and transaction-level own capital are undisclosed.
